property_summary: For any callee, C.forward(...) always returns (does not revert) exactly when the low-level call to that callee succeeds; the mutant negates the success flag and thus reverts exactly when the low-level call succeeds (and vice versa), so there exist callees that make the reference succeed but the mutant revert.
change_summary: Invert the boolean capture so the local uses the negation of the call result and require on that negation, causing opposite revert behavior.
